look: Phone in hand: The app on a floating phone, taps landing and counters ticking up live. Show both the staff check-in and the admin view.

scenes.name: The alarm
scenes.desc: The alarm sounds and one question lands: who is actually out?

scenes.name: Where to go
scenes.desc: A staff phone floats in showing the evacuation and today's assembly point.

scenes.name: Check in
scenes.desc: A name is typed, the safe button is tapped, GPS confirms 32 m from the point.

scenes.name: The admin view
scenes.desc: The admin phone counts people in live as the accountability curve climbs.

scenes.name: Nobody missed
scenes.desc: A misspelt name is matched to the staff list and the count reaches 100%.

scenes.name: AI debrief
scenes.desc: After the drill, one tap has AI write a short debrief of the evacuation.

scenes.name: End card
scenes.desc: Evacuation Roll Call: every person, accounted for.
